text:
maya: Quick UX sync — did a focused pass on the Routing Policies editor. Two main things: the priority drag-handle feels fiddly and the preview simulation needs to show why a rule fired (or didn't). Screenshot attached (see thread).

kyle: saw it — agree on drag handle. On smaller screens it's almost impossible to hit. Suggestion: add compact handles + optional up/down chevrons for keyboard users.

tara: +1 to chevrons. Keyboard users should be able to reorder with focus and aria-live announcements. e.g., when a rule moves: "Rule 3 moved to position 1" (screen reader).

sam: Can we add a visual affordance for the active drop zone? Right now when you drag, the insertion line is thin and hard to see against the gray grid. Maybe a thicker blue bar with 2px shadow.

linh: Also accessibility contrast — the priority chip text (white on #6b6b6b) is below 4.5:1. Need darker chip background or bold text.

maya: Good call. Copy nits too: the primary button currently says "Add rule" — Product wants "Create rule" to match the rest of the console. Also change placeholder "No rules yet" -> "No routing rules configured".

alex: On validation messages, current toast shows "Invalid rule" with no detail. We should surface inline errors on the rule row: e.g., `Rule 2: condition has unreachable predicate (always true upstream)`. That helps debugging.

kyle: For unreachable logic, we should detect parent 'catch-all' rules and mark subsequent rules as "inactive due to preceding match". UI could show an eye-off icon + tooltip.

maya: Proposed error copy for inline banner: "This rule will never run because a higher-priority rule matches all traffic. Consider moving or narrowing the higher rule." Thoughts?

tara: Wording is fine but long for the row. Maybe keep the row short: "Never runs — higher-priority catch-all" and full explanation in tooltip/expanded panel.

design-bot: Preview build for these changes is live at https://staging.redwood.ai/policies/preview/1860001234 — sim toggles, keyboard reordering, improved contrast. (deployed by ci/builder)

sam: Tested the preview. Simulation pane now highlights the matched rule and shows the evaluation path — love it. Two issues: 1) sample request selector is buried, make it top-left; 2) sometimes sim shows "approximate latency" which confuses PMs. Could we label it clearly: "Estimated latency (sampling model)"?

linh: Also accessibility: when you run simulation the matched rule should be announced for screen readers. Right now nothing is announced.

kyle: For reordering controls, micro-interaction idea: animate the moved card and show temporary ghost at original spot. Helps orientation. Keep animation short (160ms).

maya: Good microcopy for sim legend: "Preview sim explains which rule matches for a representative request. Use sample inputs to test fallthroughs. Results are illustrative and may vary under load."

alex: One more UX edge: when user edits a rule and saves, the preview should auto-refresh and preserve the focused rule if it still exists. Currently it collapses and you lose context.

maya: Plan: implement chevrons + drag handles, make drop zone more visible, fix contrast, add inline validation messages + tooltip details, improve sim legend and SR announcements. I'll open follow-ups in product board and assign to eng.

tara: I'll draft the exact ARIA announcements and a short accessibility test checklist.

sam: I'll create small visuals for the thicker insertion bar + animation spec.

kyle: I'll wire up keyboard reordering and small animation timings.

maya: Thanks team — will triage in planning. :thumbsup:

alex: one tiny copy tweak request before we close: change button "Run simulation" -> "Run preview" to align with preview panel name.

maya: noted. Closing notes: attach the screenshot + a quick Loom with tab/key flows.

design-bot: ticket created: POL-4823 (priority editor UX) — https://redwood.ai/board/POL-4823

maya: end.
